name: Romantasy
hint: The romance's four phases braided with a fantasy plot: the world makes the obstacles, and love decides the battle.

parts.title: Two worlds
chapters: The main character, the burden and what they are willing to do.
The two meet, and the friction sparks.
A secret and a world of their own.
A quest, a pact or a bond ties them together.

parts.title: Drawn closer
chapters: A power or a heritage begins to show, and it has a price.
A moment that almost becomes more.
The first kiss, as the fantasy plot turns.

parts.title: Betrayal and choice
chapters: A secret comes out and everything falls apart.
They go separate ways when all seems lost.

parts.title: What remains
chapters: The grand gesture is part of the deciding battle.
A happy ending, or a promise that holds until the next book.
